# truenas_boot_environment (Resource)

Manages a TrueNAS boot environment. Boot environments are always created by cloning an existing one; there is no plain create.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Boot environments are created by CLONING an existing one.
# Take a safety snapshot of the running system before an upgrade:
resource "truenas_boot_environment" "pre_upgrade" {
  name   = "pre-upgrade-backup"
  source = "26.0.0-BETA.1" # BE to clone from (usually the active one)
  keep   = true            # survive automatic cleanup
}

# Clone and make it the boot default on next reboot.
# NOTE: activated can only go false -> true. To deactivate, activate a
# different boot environment instead.
resource "truenas_boot_environment" "rollback_target" {
  name      = "known-good"
  source    = "26.0.0-BETA.1"
  activated = false
}

# Look up the currently active BE.
data "truenas_boot_environment" "current" {
  name = "26.0.0-BETA.1"
}

output "current_be" {
  value = {
    dataset    = data.truenas_boot_environment.current.dataset
    active     = data.truenas_boot_environment.current.active
    used_bytes = data.truenas_boot_environment.current.used_bytes
  }
}

# Deleting the resource destroys the BE — refused if it is the active or
# activated one.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the new boot environment (clone target).
- `source` (String) Name of the existing boot environment to clone from.

### Optional

- `activated` (Boolean) Whether this boot environment is activated (will be booted next). Setting this to true activates the boot environment. Setting it back to false is not supported by the API; activate a different boot environment instead.
- `keep` (Boolean) Whether this boot environment is protected from automatic pruning.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether this boot environment is currently booted.
- `dataset` (String) ZFS dataset backing this boot environment.
- `id` (String) Boot environment name (used as Terraform ID).
- `used_bytes` (Number) Space used by this boot environment, in bytes.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import truenas_boot_environment.pre_upgrade pre-upgrade-backup
```
